ion findTarget(record)
    local root = record.horseRoot
    if not root then return end

    -- Event ambushers keep the Old Cowboy as their primary target while he is
    -- alive and within the dedicated 300 stud escort threat radius.
    if record.model:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.OldCowboyAmbusher) then
        local closestCompanion
        local closestCompanionSquared = 300 * 300
        for _, companion in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.OldCowboyCompanion)) do
            local alive, _, companionRoot = characterIsAlive(companion)
            if alive then
                local offset = companionRoot.Position - root.Position
                local distanceSquared = offset:Dot(offset)
                if distanceSquared <= closestCompanionSquared then
                    closestCompanionSquared = distanceSquared
                    closestCompanion = companion
                end
            end
        end
        if closestCompanion then
            return {model = closestCompanion}
        end
    end

    local maxDistance = tonumber(record.lo.aggroDistance) or 60
    local maxDistanceSquared = maxDistance * maxDistance
    local closestTarget
    local closestSquared = maxDistanceSquared
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local alive, _, playerRoot = characterIsAlive(player.Character)
        if alive then
            local offset = playerRoot.Position - root.Position
            local distanceSquared = offset:Dot(offset)
            if distanceSquared <= closestSquared then
                closestSquared = distanceSquared
                closestTarget = {model = player.Character, player = player}
            end
        end
    end
    return closestTarget
end

local function getTargetData(record)
    local target = record.target
    if not target then return nil end

    local player = target.player
    local character = target.model
    if player and player.Character ~= character then
        return nil
    end

    local alive, humanoid, root = characterIsAlive(character)
    if not alive then
        return nil
    end

    local mountedRoot = record.horseRoot
    local maxDistance = (record.model:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.OldCowboyAmbusher) and not player)
        and 300
        or (tonumber(record.lo.aggroDistance) or 60)
    if mountedRoot and (root.Position - mountedRoot.Position).Magnitude > maxDistance then
        return nil
    end
    return target, character, humanoid, root
end

local function hasLineOfSight(record, character)
    if not character or not record.model:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
        return false
    end
    local ok, blocked = pcall(function()
        return EnemyHelper:IsModelObstructionByCollsionGroup(record.model, character)
    end)
    return ok and not blocked
end

local function playNpcHitFeedback(model)
    local root = model and (model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model.PrimaryPart)
    if not root then return end
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - (lastHitSoundAt[model] or -math.huge) < 0.08 then return end
    lastHitSoundAt[model] = now
    pcall(function()
        AudioHelper:PlayEffect(hitSounds[math.random(1,#hitSounds)], root, {
            FallbackPosition = root.Position,
            SourceKey = "mounted-npc-hit:" .. tostring(model),
        })
    end)
end

local function applyDamageToTarget(record, target, character, damage, hitContext, damageSource)
    if not target or not character then return false end
    local ok, accepted = pcall(function()
        if target.player then
            return GameHelper:PlayerTakeDamage(target.player, damage, record.model, nil, hitContext)
        end
        return GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(record.model, character, damage, damageSource, hitContext)
    end)
    if not ok or accepted ~= true then
        return false
    end
    if not target.player then
        playNpcHitFeedback(character)
    end
    return true
end

local function applyMelee(record, target, character, token)
    local alive, _, targetRoot = characterIsAlive(character)
    local root = record.horseRoot
    if not alive or not root or not targetRoot then return false end

    local attackDistance = tonumber(record.lo.attackDistance) or 9
    if (targetRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude > attackDistance + 2 then
        return false
    end
    if not hasLineOfSight(record, character) then
        return false
    end

    local damage = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(record.model, enemyValue.atkDamage) or record.lo.atkDamage or 0
    if damage <= 0 then return false end

    local direction = targetRoot.Position - record.riderRoot.Position
    if direction.Magnitude < 0.01 then
        direction = root.CFrame.LookVector
    else
        direction = direction.Unit
    end

    local hitContext = {
        DamageSource = GameEnum.DamageSource.MeleeWeapon,
        HitPosition = targetRoot.Position,
        HitDirection = direction,
        AttackKind = "MountedMelee",
        AttackToken = token,
    }

    if not applyDamageToTarget(record, target, character, damage, hitContext, GameEnum.DamageSource.MeleeWeapon) then
        return false
    end

    if target.player then
        local hungerDamage = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(record.model, enemyValue.hungerDamage)
        if hungerDamage and hungerDamage > 0 then
            GameHelper:PlayerTakeHungerDamage(target.player, hungerDamage, record.model)
        end
    end
    return true
end

local function startMeleeAttack(record, target, character)
    if record.dead or record.pendingMelee or record.cooldown > 0 then
        return false
    end

    record.attackToken += 1
    local token = record.attackToken
    record.pendingMelee = {
        token = token,
        target = target,
        character = character,
    }
    record.pendingClock = MOUNTED_CONFIG.meleeAttackWindup
    record.meleeDone = false
    record.cooldown = tonumber(record.lo.attackCD) or 1.3

    restartTrack(record.attackTrack, 0.03)
    local tool = record.model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")
    local source = tool and tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") or record.riderRoot
    pcall(function()
        AudioHelper:PlayEffect(swingSounds[math.random(1,#swingSounds)], source)
    end)
    return true
end

local function resolveMeleeAttack(record)
    local pending = record.pendingMelee
    if not pending then return false end
    record.pendingMelee = nil
    record.pendingClock = 0

    if record.dead or isFrozen(record.model) then
        record.meleeDone = true
        return false
    end

    local accepted = applyMelee(record, pending.target, pending.character, pending.token)
    record.meleeDone = true
    return accepted
end

local function cancelMeleeAttack(record)
    record.attackToken += 1
    record.pendingMelee = nil
    record.pendingClock = 0
    record.meleeDone = false
end

local function fireGunVisual(record, character)
    if not visualEvent or not character then return end
    local sourceRoot = record.horseRoot
    if not sourceRoot then return end
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local alive, _, playerRoot = characterIsAlive(player.Character)
        if alive and (playerRoot.Position - sourceRoot.Position).Magnitude <= 250 then
            visualEvent:FireClient(player, record.model, character)
        end
    end
end

local function applyGunShot(record, target, character)
    local alive, _, targetRoot = characterIsAlive(character)
    local root = record.horseRoot
    if not alive or not root or not targetRoot then return false end
    local distance = (targetRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
    local attackDistance = tonumber(record.lo.attackDistance) or 24
    if distance > attackDistance then return false end
    if not hasLineOfSight(record, character) then return false end

    local damage = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(record.model, enemyValue.atkDamage) or record.lo.atkDamage or 0
    if damage <= 0 then return false end

    record.attackToken += 1
    local direction = targetRoot.Position - record.riderRoot.Position
    if direction.Magnitude < 0.01 then
        direction = root.CFrame.LookVector
    else
        direction = direction.Unit
    end
    local hitContext = {
        HitPosition = targetRoot.Position,
        HitDirection = direction,
        AttackKind = "MountedGun",
        AttackToken = record.attackToken,
    }

    if not applyDamageToTarget(record, target, character, damage, hitContext, nil) then
        return false
    end

    fireGunVisual(record, character)
    return true
end

local function getFlatDirection(direction, fallback)
    local flat = Vector3.new(direction.X, 0, direction.Z)
    if flat.Magnitude > 0.01 then
        return flat.Unit
    end

    flat = fallback and Vector3.new(fallback.X, 0, fallback.Z) or Vector3.zero
    if flat.Magnitude > 0.01 then
        return flat.Unit
    end
    return Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
end

local function createMountedUprightConstraint(horseRoot)
    if not horseRoot then return end

    local attachment = horseRoot:FindFirstChild("MountedUprightAttachment")
    if not attachment or not attachment:IsA("Attachment") then
        attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
        attachment.Name = "MountedUprightAttachment"
        attachment.Parent = horseRoot
    end

    local align = horseRoot:FindFirstChild("MountedUpright")
    if not align or not align:IsA("AlignOrientation") then
        align = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
        align.Name = "MountedUpright"
        align.Parent = horseRoot
    end

    align.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
    align.Attachment0 = attachment
    align.AlignType = Enum.AlignType.AllAxes
    align.PrimaryAxisOnly = false
    align.RigidityEnabled = true
    align.MaxTorque = math.huge
    align.MaxAngularVelocity = math.huge
    align.Responsiveness = 200
    align.ReactionTorqueEnabled = false
    return align
end

local function updateMountedFacing(record, direction)
    local fallback = record.facingDirection
    if not fallback and record.horseRoot then
        fallback = record.horseRoot.CFrame.LookVector
    end

    local facing = getFlatDirection(direction, fallback)
    record.facingDirection = facing
    if record.uprightAlign then
        record.uprightAlign.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, facing, Vector3.yAxis)
    end
    return facing
end

local function setMove(record, direction, speed)
    local humanoid = record.horseHumanoid
    if not humanoid then return end

    local horizontal = Vector3.new(direction.X, 0, direction.Z)
    local moving = horizontal.Magnitude > 0.01
    local facing = updateMountedFacing(record, horizontal)

    if moving then
        humanoid.WalkSpeed = speed or record.lo.speed or 20
        humanoid:Move(facing, false)
        playHorseMovement(record, true)
    else
        humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
        playHorseMovement(record, false)
    end
end

local function randomRange(minimum, maximum)
    return minimum + math.random() * (maximum - minimum)
end

local function beginPatrolWait(record)
    record.patrolPhase = "wait"
    record.patrolTarget = nil
    record.patrolWaitClock = randomRange(MOUNTED_CONFIG.patrolIdleMin, MOUNTED_CONFIG.patrolIdleMax)
end

local function choosePatrolTarget(record)
    local range = tonumber(record.lo.wanderRange) or 0
    if range <= 0 then
        return nil
    end

    local angle = math.random() * math.pi * 2
    local radius = randomRange(
        range * MOUNTED_CONFIG.patrolMinRadiusScale,
        range * MOUNTED_CONFIG.patrolMaxRadiusScale
    )
    return record.origin + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * radius, 0, math.sin(angle) * radius)
end

local function updatePatrol(record, dt)
    local root = record.horseRoot
    if not root then
        return
    end

    local arrivalDistance = MOUNTED_CONFIG.patrolArrivalDistance
    local patrolSpeed = (tonumber(record.lo.speed) or 20) * MOUNTED_CONFIG.patrolSpeedScale

    if record.patrolPhase == "return" then
        local offset = Vector3.new(
            record.origin.X - root.Position.X,
            0,
            record.origin.Z - root.Position.Z
        )
        if offset.Magnitude <= arrivalDistance then
            beginPatrolWait(record)
            setMove(record, Vector3.zero, 0)
        else
            setMove(record, offset, patrolSpeed)
        end
        return
    end

    if record.patrolPhase == "move" then
        local target = record.patrolTarget
        local offset = target and Vector3.new(
            target.X - root.Position.X,
            0,
            target.Z - root.Position.Z
        ) or Vector3.zero
        if not target or offset.Magnitude <= arrivalDistance then
            beginPatrolWait(record)
            setMove(record, Vector3.zero, 0)
        else
            setMove(record, offset, patrolSpeed)
        end
        return
    end

    -- Waiting is the normal no-target state. The target probe still runs in
    -- updateRecord, so a player can interrupt this pause within 0.5 seconds.
    setMove(record, Vector3.zero, 0)
    local range = tonumber(record.lo.wanderRange) or 0
    if range <= 0 then
        return
    end

    record.patrolWaitClock = math.max(0, (record.patrolWaitClock or 0) - dt)
    if record.patrolWaitClock > 0 then
        return
    end

    record.patrolTarget = choosePatrolTarget(record)
    if record.patrolTarget then
        record.patrolPhase = "move"
    else
        beginPatrolWait(record)
    end
end

local function disconnectRecord(record)
    cancelMeleeAttack(record)
    for _, connection in ipairs(record.connections) do
        pcall(function()
            connection:Disconnect()
        end)
    end
    record.connections = {}
    stopTrack(record.sitTrack, 0.05)
    stopTrack(record.toolTrack, 0.05)
    stopTrack(record.attackTrack, 0.05)
    stopTrack(record.horseRide, 0.05)
    stopTrack(record.horseWalk, 0.05)
    stopTrack(record.horseFall, 0.05)
end

local function unregister(model)
    local record = records[model]
    if not record then return end
    records[model] = nil
    disconnectRecord(record)
end

local function finishDeath(record)
    if record.dead then return end
    record.dead = true
    records[record.model] = nil
    disconnectRecord(record)

    local rider = record.model

    -- EnemyDeathService owns corpse fade and final root destruction. Because the
    -- horse is a child of the rider root, it is removed by the same existing
    -- lifecycle instead of being destroyed a second time here.
    pcall(function()
        GameHelper:EnemyDeathDrop(rider)
    end)
    local tool = rider:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")
    if tool then
        tool:Destroy()
    end
    rider:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.EnemyDeath)
    -- Do not route mounted roots through the generic ragdoll service: it would
    -- dismantle MountedEnemyMotor and leave the horse falling apart.
    rider:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.MountedEnemy)
    rider:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.Enemy)
    rider:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.Bandit)

end

local function register(model)
    if records[model] or not model:IsA("Model") then return end
    if not model:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return end

    local riderHumanoid = getHumanoid(model)
    local horse
    for _, child in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Model") and child:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.MountedHorse) then
            horse = child
            break
        end
    end
    if not riderHumanoid or not horse then return end

    local horseHumanoid = getHumanoid(horse)
    local riderRoot = getRoot(model)
    local horseRoot = getRoot(horse)
    if not horseHumanoid or not riderRoot or not horseRoot then return end

    local id = model:GetAttribute("MountedEnemyId")
    local lo = id and EnemyHelper:GetLo(id)
    if not lo then return end

    local animator = riderHumanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator")
    animator.Parent = riderHumanoid
    local horseAnimator = horseHumanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator")
    horseAnimator.Parent = horseHumanoid

    local animations = model:FindFirstChild("Animations")
    local horseAnimations = horse:FindFirstChild("Animations", true)
    local record = {
        model = model,
        lo = lo,
        riderHumanoid = riderHumanoid,
        riderRoot = riderRoot,
        horse = horse,
        horseHumanoid = horseHumanoid,
        horseRoot = horseRoot,
        uprightAlign = createMountedUprightConstraint(horseRoot),
        facingDirection = getFlatDirection(horseRoot.CFrame.LookVector),
        target = nil,
        origin = EnemyHelper:GetCustomOriginPos(model) or model:GetPivot().Position,
        state = "idle",
        stateClock = 0,
        cooldown = 0,
        attackToken = 0,
        pendingMelee = nil,
        pendingClock = 0,
        meleeDone = false,
        strafeDirection = 1,
        strafeClock = MOUNTED_CONFIG.strafeSwitchTime,
        patrolPhase = "wait",
        patrolWaitClock = randomRange(MOUNTED_CONFIG.patrolIdleMin, MOUNTED_CONFIG.patrolIdleMax),
        patrolTarget = nil,
        wasInCombat = false,
        dead = false,
        connections = {},
    }
    records[model] = record

    if not EnemyHelper:GetCustomOriginPos(model) then
        EnemyHelper:SetCustomOriginPos(model, record.origin)
    end

    local sitAnimation = makeAnimation("MountedSit", 178130996)
    record.sitTrack = loadTrack(animator, sitAnimation, true, Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement)

    local attackAnimation = findAnimation(animations, {"attack"})
    record.attackTrack = loadTrack(animator, attackAnimation, false, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action2)
    if record.attackTrack then
        table.insert(record.connections, record.attackTrack:GetMarkerReachedSignal("Hit"):Connect(function()
            if not record.dead then
                resolveMeleeAttack(record)
            end
        end))
    end
    local toolAnimation = findAnimation(animations, {"tool"})
    record.toolTrack = loadTrack(animator, toolAnimation, true, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action)

    local horseRide = findAnimation(horseAnimations, {"Ride", "Idle"})
    local horseWalk = findAnimation(horseAnimations, {"Walk"})
    local horseFall = findAnimation(horseAnimations, {"Fall"})
    horseRide = horseRide or makeAnimation("Ride", 289454972)
    horseWalk = horseWalk or makeAnimation("Walk", 289443727)
    horseFall = horseFall or makeAnimation("Fall", 289878116)
    record.horseRide = loadTrack(horseAnimator, horseRide, true, Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement)
    record.horseWalk = loadTrack(horseAnimator, horseWalk, true, Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement)
    record.horseFall = loadTrack(horseAnimator, horseFall, true, Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement)

    local tool = model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")
    if tool then
        pcall(function()
            riderHumanoid:EquipTool(tool)
        end)
        playTrack(record.toolTrack, 0.15)
    end
    playTrack(record.sitTrack, 0.15)
    playHorseMovement(record, false)

    -- The ordinary horse controller disables these states before taking
    -- control. Mounted enemies keep the horse server-driven, so apply the
    -- same state policy here and let MountedUpright own rotation.
    horseHumanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, false)
    horseHumanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown, false)
    horseHumanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing, false)
    horseHumanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming, false)
    horseHumanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.RunningNoPhysics, false)
    horseHumanoid.AutoRotate = false
    updateMountedFacing(record, record.facingDirection)
    setNetworkOwnerServer(model)
    horseHumanoid.WalkSpeed = lo.speed or 20

    table.insert(record.connections, model.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
        if not parent then
            unregister(model)
        end
    end))
    table.insert(record.connections, riderHumanoid.Died:Connect(function()
        finishDeath(record)
    end))
    table.insert(record.connections, riderHumanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function(health)
        if health <= 0 then
            finishDeath(record)
        end
    end))
    table.insert(record.connections, horseHumanoid.Died:Connect(function()
        if not record.dead and record.model:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
            record.model:Destroy()
        end
    end))
end

local function updateLancer(record, dt, target, character, targetRoot)
    local root = record.horseRoot
    local lo = record.lo
    local distance = (targetRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
    local attackDistance = tonumber(lo.attackDistance) or 9
    local prepDistance = MOUNTED_CONFIG.chargePrepDistance
    local retreatDistance = MOUNTED_CONFIG.chargeRetreatDistance

    if record.state == "chargeWindup" then
        setMove(record, Vector3.zero, 0)
        record.stateClock -= dt
        if record.stateClock <= 0 then
            local direction = Vector3.new(targetRoot.Position.X - root.Position.X, 0, targetRoot.Position.Z - root.Position.Z)
            if direction.Magnitude < 0.1 then
                direction = root.CFrame.LookVector
            end
            record.chargeDirection = direction.Unit
            record.state = "charge"
            record.stateClock = MOUNTED_CONFIG.chargeDuration
            record.meleeDone = false
        end
        return
    end

    if record.state == "charge" then
        record.stateClock -= dt
        setMove(record, record.chargeDirection or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1), MOUNTED_CONFIG.chargeSpeed)

        if not record.pendingMelee
            and not record.meleeDone
            and record.cooldown <= 0
            and distance <= attackDistance + 2 then
            startMeleeAttack(record, target, character)
        end

        if record.pendingMelee then
            record.pendingClock -= dt
            if record.pendingClock <= 0 then
                resolveMeleeAttack(record)
            end
        end

        if record.meleeDone or record.stateClock <= 0 then
            if record.pendingMelee then
                resolveMeleeAttack(record)
            end
            record.state = "retreat"
            record.stateClock = 1.2
        end
        return
    end

    if record.state == "retreat" then
        record.stateClock -= dt
        local direction = -(record.chargeDirection or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1))
        setMove(record, direction, lo.speed or 24)
        if distance >= retreatDistance or record.stateClock <= 0 then
            record.state = "idle"
        end
        return
    end

    record.cooldown = math.max(0, record.cooldown - dt)
    if distance <= prepDistance and record.cooldown <= 0 then
        record.state = "chargeWindup"
        record.stateClock = MOUNTED_CONFIG.chargeWindup
        setMove(record, Vector3.zero, 0)
        return
    end
    local direction = Vector3.new(targetRoot.Position.X - root.Position.X, 0, targetRoot.Position.Z - root.Position.Z)
    setMove(record, direction, lo.speed or 24)
end

local function updateGunslinger(record, dt, target, character, targetRoot)
    local root = record.horseRoot
    local lo = record.lo
    local distance = (targetRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
    local outerDistance = MOUNTED_CONFIG.strafeOuterDistance
    local innerDistance = MOUNTED_CONFIG.strafeInnerDistance
    local strafeDistance = MOUNTED_CONFIG.strafeDistance

    record.cooldown = math.max(0, record.cooldown - dt)
    record.strafeClock -= dt
    if record.strafeClock <= 0 then
        record.strafeDirection *= -1
        record.strafeClock = MOUNTED_CONFIG.strafeSwitchTime
    end

    local offset = Vector3.new(targetRoot.Position.X - root.Position.X, 0, targetRoot.Position.Z - root.Position.Z)
    local toward = offset.Magnitude > 0.1 and offset.Unit or root.CFrame.LookVector
    local direction
    if distance > outerDistance then
        direction = toward
    elseif distance < innerDistance then
        direction = -toward
    else
        local right = Vector3.new(-toward.Z, 0, toward.X)
        direction = right * record.strafeDirection
        if strafeDistance > distance then
            direction = (direction + toward * 0.2).Unit
        end
    end
    setMove(record, direction, lo.speed or 23)

    if record.cooldown <= 0 and distance <= outerDistance then
        record.shotClock = (record.shotClock or MOUNTED_CONFIG.gunAttackWindup) - dt
        if record.shotClock <= 0 then
            if applyGunShot(record, target, character) then
                playTrack(record.attackTrack, 0.03)
                record.cooldown = tonumber(lo.attackCD) or 1.2
            end
            record.shotClock = nil
        end
    else
        record.shotClock = nil
    end
end

local function updateRecord(record, dt)
    if record.dead or not record.model:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
        unregister(record.model)
        return
    end
    if not record.horse:IsDescendantOf(record.model) or record.horseRoot.Position.Y < -200 then
        record.model:Destroy()
        unregister(record.model)
        return
    end
    if record.riderHumanoid.Health <= 0 then
        finishDeath(record)
        return
    end
    if isFrozen(record.model) then
        cancelMeleeAttack(record)
        record.riderHumanoid.WalkSpeed = 0
        setMove(record, Vector3.zero, 0)
        stopTrack(record.attackTrack, 0.05)
        return
    end

    record.targetClock = (record.targetClock or 0) - dt
    if record.targetClock <= 0 then
        record.targetClock = 0.5
        local currentTarget, currentCharacter = getTargetData(record)
        if not currentTarget or not currentCharacter then
            record.target = findTarget(record)
        end
        local selectedTarget, selectedCharacter = getTargetData(record)
        if not selectedTarget or not selectedCharacter then
            record.target = findTarget(record)
        end
    end

    local target, character, _, targetRoot = getTargetData(record)
    if not target or not character or not targetRoot then
        record.target = nil
        if record.wasInCombat then
            record.wasInCombat = false
            record.patrolPhase = "return"
            record.patrolTarget = nil
            record.patrolWaitClock = 0
        end
        updatePatrol(record, dt)
        return
    end

    record.wasInCombat = true
    record.patrolTarget = nil

    local style = (record.lo.attackType == "Gun" and "Gunslinger" or "Lancer")
    if style == "Gunslinger" then
        updateGunslinger(record, dt, target, character, targetRoot)
    else
        updateLancer(record, dt, target, character, targetRoot)
    end
end

local function startScheduler()
    if schedulerConnection then return end
    schedulerConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        schedulerAccumulator += dt
        if schedulerAccumulator < 0.1 then return end
        local step = schedulerAccumulator
        schedulerAccumulator = 0
        for _, record in pairs(records) do
            local ok, err = pcall(updateRecord, record, step)
            if not ok then
                warn("[MountedEnemy] update failed:", err)
                unregister(record.model)
            end
        end
    end)
end

local _enemyParent = Instance.new("Folder")
_enemyParent.Name = "塔防模式夜袭敌人"
_enemyParent.Parent = workspace

local _campfire:Model = MapHelper:GetCampfire()
local t_enemys:TextLabel = _campfire:FindFirstChild("t_enemys",true)

local _attackTimes = 0

local TAG = "NightAttackEneny"
function init()
    if v_gameMode.Value ~= CommonEnum.Mode.TowerDefense then return end
    if not MapHelper.isInit then return end
    if _init then return end

    _init = true
    -- 第一晚就夜袭
    v_attackedCD.Value = 999

    -- 移除原版夜袭脚本
    game.ServerScriptService.Game:FindFirstChild("营地突袭"):Destroy()
    -- 刷新敌人数量
    updateEnemyNum()
end

function updateEnemyNum()
    local num = #CollectionService:GetTagged(TAG)

    local text = ""
    for i=1,num do
        text = text .. "🤠"
    end
    t_enemys.Text = text
end

function spawnAttackEnemys()
    local thisAttackTimes = _attackTimes
    local campfire:Model = MapHelper:GetCampfire()
    local ranged = GameHelper:GetCampfireRange() + 20
    local campfireCFrame = campfire:GetPivot()
    local campfirePos = campfireCFrame.Position

    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    raycastParams:AddToFilter(MapHelper:GetWantedBoard())
    raycastParams:AddToFilter(MapHelper:GetCraftingBenchModels())
    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

    local lo:CampRaidSetting.Type = ConfigHelper:GetById(CampRaidSetting,_waveId)
    local enemyIds = string.split(lo.enemyIds,",")
    local enemyNum = 0

    local spawnEnemy = function(enemyId:number)
        local spawnPos:Vector3
        for i=1,20 do
            local x,z = CommonFunc:GetDir2D(math.random() * 2 * math.pi)
            spawnPos = MapHelper:GetLandingPoint(Vector3.new(x * ranged,campfirePos.Y,z * ranged))
            local point = MapHelper:GetSafeLandingPoint(spawnPos)
            if point then
                -- 检测是否被悬赏牌和马车阻挡
                local hitResult:RaycastResult = workspace:Raycast(point,(campfirePos - point).Unit * 100,raycastParams)
                if not hitResult then
                    spawnPos = point
                    break
                else
                    -- print(hitResult.Instance.Name)
                end
            end
        end

        local enemy:Model = EnemyHelper:Create(enemyId,_enemyParent)
        enemy:PivotTo(CFrame.new(spawnPos))
        enemy:AddTag(TAG)

        local targetPos = campfire:GetPivot().Position
        EnemyHelper:SetCustomOriginPos(enemy,targetPos)

        local humanoid:Humanoid = enemy:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        humanoid:MoveTo(targetPos)
        humanoid.Died:Once(function()
            enemy:RemoveTag(TAG)
            enemyNum -= 1

            local position = enemy:GetPivot().Position
            if enemyNum == 0 then
                -- 掉落黄金
                ResourcesItemHelper:CreateGold(position)
                GameHelper.onCampfireAttackCompleted:Fire()

                local v_awardGemTimes:IntValue = game.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("TowerDefense模式数值"):FindFirstChild("每n次夜袭奖励1个Gem")
                if thisAttackTimes % v_awardGemTimes.Value == 0 then
                    UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireAllClients("💎Thank you for your protection of the campfire. You have earned a Gem reward.")
                    -- 每个人奖励Gem
                    for _,player:Player in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
                        GameHelper:AwardGem(player,1)
                    end
                end
            else
                -- 根据随即组掉落
                ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItemsByRandomId(207,position)
            end
        end)
        enemyNum += 1
    end

    local v_mul:IntValue = game.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("TowerDefense模式数值"):FindFirstChild("夜袭敌人数量倍数")
    for mul=1,v_mul.Value do
        for _,emenyIdStr in ipairs(enemyIds) do
            spawnEnemy(tonumber(emenyIdStr))
        end
    end

    -- 大只佬刷出机制
    local v_bigEnemyNight:IntValue = game.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("TowerDefense模式数值"):FindFirstChild("每n波增加一个大只佬")
    local v_bigEnemyNumMax:IntValue = game.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("TowerDefense模式数值"):FindFirstChild("大只佬最大数量")
    -- local bigEnemyLos:{EnemySetting.Type} = ConfigHelper:Get(EnemySetting,EnemySetting.k.isDestroyer,true,true)
    local bigEnemyNum = math.clamp(math.floor(_attackTimes / v_bigEnemyNight.Value),0,v_bigEnemyNumMax.Value)
    local bigEnemyIds = {501,502}
    for i=1,bigEnemyNum do
        -- local enemyLo = bigEnemyLos[i % #bigEnemyLos + 1]
        -- local enemyId = enemyLo.id
        -- spawnEnemy(enemyId)
        local enemyId = bigEnemyIds[i % #bigEnemyIds + 1]
        spawnEnemy(enemyId)
    end
end

init()
v_gameMode.Changed:Connect(init)
v_isDaytime.Changed:Connect(function(value)
    if GameHelper:getCurMode() ~= CommonEnum.Mode.TowerDefense then
        script:Destroy()
        return
    end
    if v_isDaytime.Value then
        v_attackedCD.Value += 1
    else
        task.defer(function()
            -- 把营地附近的尸体全部吸到营火那里
            local op = OverlapParams.new()
            op:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.DeadBody))
            op.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

            local campfire:Model = MapHelper:GetCampfire()
            local campfirePos = campfire:GetPivot().Position
            local tweenEndCFrame = CFrame.new(campfirePos + Vector3.new(0,5,0))
            local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(campfire:GetPivot().Position,100,op)
            local marks = {}
            for _,hit in ipairs(hits) do
                local isResItem,resItem = ResourcesItemHelper:IsResourcesItem(hit)
                if not isResItem then continue end
                if table.find(marks,resItem) then continue end
                table.insert(marks,resItem)
                if ValueHelper:FindValueValue(resItem,DragItemValue.dragPlayer) then continue end
                if not resItem.PrimaryPart then continue end
                ValueHelper:SetValue(resItem,DragItemValue.enable,false)

                resItem.PrimaryPart.Anchored = true
                local tween = TweenService:Create(resItem.PrimaryPart,TweenInfo.new(1),{
                    CFrame = tweenEndCFrame
                })
                tween.Completed:Connect(function()
                    resItem.PrimaryPart.Anchored = false
                end)
                tween:Play()
            end
        end)

        -- 夜晚
        local isCanAttack = GameHelper:IsCanAttackCampfire()
        if isCanAttack then
            UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireAllClients("There are bad guys approaching the campfire.",UIHelper.TipsStyle.Event)
            task.wait(10)
            if not v_isDaytime.Value then
                _waveId += 1
                _attackTimes += 1
                if _waveId > #CampRaidSetting.data then
                    _waveId = #CampRaidSetting.data
                end
                v_attackedCD.Value = 0
                GameHelper.onStartCampfireAttack:Fire()
                spawnAttackEnemys()
            end
        end
    end
end)

local v_gameMode = workspace.GameValue:FindFirstChild("游戏模式")

function init()
    if v_gameMode.Value ~= CommonEnum.Mode.BountyHunter and v_gameMode.Value ~= CommonEnum.Mode.Mares then return end

	local v_dones = GameHelper:GetWantedKillList()
    local saveOutlaws = {}
    GameHelper.onStartCampfireAttack.Event:Connect(function()
        -- local cowboy = workspace:FindFirstChild("Prefabs"):FindFirstChild("敌人"):FindFirstChild("解救神枪手牛仔"):Clone()
        print("会有牛仔解救神枪手")
        local cowboy:Model = nil
        for i=1,4 do
            local id = 5-i
            local v_done = v_dones[id]
            if v_done.Value and not saveOutlaws[id] then
                if not cowboy then
                    cowboy = workspace:FindFirstChild("Prefabs"):FindFirstChild("敌人"):FindFirstChild("解救神枪手牛仔"):Clone()
                    cowboy:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.RescueCowboy)
                    cowboy.Parent = workspace

                    local track:AnimationTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(cowboy,78644037646445)
                    track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
                    track.Looped = true
                    track:Play()

                    local isDied = false

                    local humanoid:Humanoid = cowboy:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
                    humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function()
                        if isDied then return end
                        if humanoid.Health <= 0 then
                            isDied = true
                            track:Stop()
                            cowboy:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.RescueCowboy)
                            cowboy:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.PlayerRagdoll)
                            Debris:AddItem(cowboy,2)
                            cowboy = nil
                        end
                    end)
                end

                print("正在拯救神枪手",id)
                if trySaveOutlaw(cowboy,id) then
                    saveOutlaws[id] = true
                    GameHelper.setArresteeVisible:Fire(id,false)
                    local lo = EnemyHelper:GetWantedLo(id)
                    local cframe:CFrame = GameHelper.getCampfireArresteeCFrame:Invoke(id)
                    local boss = EnemyHelper:Create(lo.bossId)
                    boss:PivotTo(cframe + Vector3.new(0,3,0))
                    boss.Parent = workspace

                    local isDied = false
                    local humanoid:Humanoid = boss:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
                    humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function()
                        if isDied then return end
                        if humanoid.Health <= 0 then
                            isDied = true
                            saveOutlaws[id] = false
                            GameHelper.setArresteeVisible:Fire(id,true)
                            -- boss:Destroy() -- 不能直接销毁，这不符合寿命周期流程
                            boss:PivotTo(CFrame.new(0,-300,0))
                            Debris:AddItem(boss,1)
                        end
                    end)

                    AudioHelper:PlayEffect("匪徒解救神枪手成功")
                else
                    return
                end
            end
        end

        if cowboy then
            cowboy:Destroy()
            cowboy = nil
        end
    end)
end

function trySaveOutlaw(cowboy:Model,id:number)
    UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireAllClients("The outlaw is trying to rescue the wanted man! Stop him quickly!",UIHelper.TipsStyle.Warn)
    local cframe:CFrame = GameHelper.getCampfireArresteeCFrame:Invoke(id)
    if cframe then
        cowboy:PivotTo(cframe - cframe.LookVector * 3 + Vector3.new(0,3,0))
    end
    local Slide:ImageLabel = cowboy:FindFirstChild("Head"):FindFirstChild("BillboardGui"):FindFirstChild("Bg"):FindFirstChild("Slide")
    Slide.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0,Slide.Size.Y.Scale)

    local cd = workspace.GameValue:FindFirstChild("解救神枪手速度").Value
    local endTime = workspace.DistributedGameTime + cd
    while true do
        if not GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(cowboy) then return false end
        local timeNow = workspace.DistributedGameTime

        -- 刷新进度条
        Slide.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1 - math.clamp((endTime - timeNow) / cd,0,1),Slide.Size.Y.Scale)
        if timeNow >= endTime then
            task.wait(1)
            break
        end
        task.wait(1)
    end

    return true
end

init()

local v_gameMode = workspace.GameValue:FindFirstChild("游戏模式")

function initPlayer(player:Player)
    if v_gameMode.Value ~= CommonEnum.Mode.BountyHunter then return end
    if player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Reconnection) then return end
    if player:HasTag("InitOfBountyHunter") then return end
    player:AddTag("InitOfBountyHunter")

    task.wait(1)

    local guns = {
        {ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(601),game.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("BountyHunter模式数值"):FindFirstChild("初始添加手枪子弹数量").Value},
        -- {ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(602),game.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("BountyHunter模式数值"):FindFirstChild("初始添加步枪子弹数量").Value},
        -- {ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(603),game.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("BountyHunter模式数值"):FindFirstChild("初始添加散弹枪枪子弹数量").Value}, -- 默认有30发，所以只给50发
    }

    for _,vo in ipairs(guns) do
        local gun:Model = vo[1]
        local bulletNum = vo[2]

        local resItemLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(gun)
        if bulletNum > 0 and resItemLo.ItemType == GameEnum.Tag.Gun then
            -- 每种枪+n发子弹
            GameHelper:AddBullet(player,tonumber(resItemLo.param),bulletNum)
        end
        if GameHelper:TryPinkup(player,gun) then

        else
            -- 拿不了，不能重复拿，销毁掉
            ResourcesItemHelper:DestroyItem(gun)
        end
    end

    -- 装备一个大袋
    local bag = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(102)
    if not GameHelper:TryPinkup(player,bag) then
        -- 拿不了就不要重复拿
        ResourcesItemHelper:DestroyItem(bag)

end

function init()
    if v_gameMode.Value ~= CommonEnum.Mode.BountyHunter then return end

    math.randomseed(tick())

    local buildingEnemies = {}
    GameHelper.BuildingEnterC2S.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player,building:Model)
        if not buildingEnemies[building] then
            -- 初始化额外敌人数量
            local defaultAttFolder:Folder = building:FindFirstChild("敌人生成点")
            if defaultAttFolder then
                local childs = defaultAttFolder:GetChildren()
                buildingEnemies[building] = #childs
            else
                buildingEnemies[building] = game.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("BountyHunter模式数值"):FindFirstChild("资源点生成敌人数量").Value
            end
        end

        -- 已清理这个建筑的额外敌人
        if buildingEnemies[building] == 0 then return end

        local zoneLv = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByPos(building:GetPivot().Position)
        local enemyLos = ConfigHelper:Get(EnemySetting,EnemySetting.k.BountyHunterLv,zoneLv,true)
        if #enemyLos == 0 then
            -- 该区域不刷新额外敌人
            buildingEnemies[building] = 0
            return
        end

        local enemiesFolder = building:FindFirstChild("赏金猎人模式敌人实例")
        if not enemiesFolder then
            enemiesFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
            enemiesFolder.Name = "赏金猎人模式敌人实例"
            enemiesFolder.Parent = building
